partner_json_extract.why_now: India has live clean-ferry proof, airport/port expansion, and a visible gap for one operator to own the national water-mobility layer.
partner_json_extract.network_thesis: Adani Ports & SEZ × Navier — own and run Navier India | One India operator should own the marine mobility layer nationally: market-by-market pilots, shared operating standard, exact BP/route binding, then economics cascade only after source-backed demand/fare records.
partner_json_extract.multimodal_fit: Adani can connect air-side demand, port berths, logistics sites, and coastal destinations under one operating umbrella; Navier slots in as the water leg between existing infrastructure nodes.
